title: The stabilizer of an O_E-lattice is open
statement: Let E/\mathbf Q_\ell be a finite extension with valuation ring \mathcal O_E [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], let V be a finite-dimensional E-vector space with its \ell-adic topology, and let \Lambda_0\subset V be a finitely generated \mathcal O_E-submodule spanning V over E. Then the subgroup \{u\in\operatorname{GL}_E(V):u(\Lambda_0)=\Lambda_0\} is open in \operatorname{GL}_E(V) for the topology induced by the \ell-adic topology on V and the compact-open topology on linear maps.

source.place: Stanford Weil II seminar, lecture 19, Proposition 1.1.9, second bullet, p. 2: GL(Lambda_0) is an open subgroup of GL_n(E)
